subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×7=8 (a) He fell fast asleep here but a great noise woke him up. (b) It was crying for pain in his leg. (c) Androcles was very much afraid and he fell sure that the beast would kill him. (d) A lion had entered the cave roaring loudly. (e) He went to the lion. (f) Then he removed a thorn from the lion's paws. (g) Soon he realised that the lion was angry.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Jashore Board-2015 (Test Paper 127-150)
